title: Charles V-era ciphers in HHStA Frankreich Varia: Chapuys → Hannart 1535-36, the Abbot of Luxeuil → Charles V 1546, French correspondence 1547
correspondents: Eustace Chapuys → Jean Hannart; abbot of Luxeuil → Charles V; unknown
status: AIS gives no decipherment. Chapuys's despatches to Charles V are calendared (CSP Spain, Bergenroth/Gayangos) and Charles V keys are on Tomokiyo's cryptiana; the Luxeuil letters are less studied. A printed text may exist (27 Oct 2026), but the manuscript is not online, so the print cannot be matched to the cipher yet.
why: Imperial diplomacy with France on the eve of the Schmalkaldic War.

title: Peter Knorre and Rudolf Schenk von Tautenburg → Duke Wilhelm III of Saxony, reports 'vollständig' or 'größtenteils chiffriert' (Luxembourg succession)
correspondents: Peter Knorre (provost of Wetzlar), Rudolf Schenk von Tautenburg → Wilhelm III, Duke of Saxony; Wilhelm's ciphered reply 22 Dec 1462
shelfmark: Sächsisches Staatsarchiv, Hauptstaatsarchiv Dresden, 10005 Wittenberger Archiv, Loc. 4356/01, Bl. 380, 490, 494, 530, 531, 538, 540, 564, 565, 572, 574, 575
folio_note: about 12 sheets; Bl. 540 'ein Teil ist dechiffriert'; Bl. 530 'zum Teil chiffriert, deshalb meist unverständlich'
status: Archivportal-D item descriptions: 'vollständig chiffriert', 'größtenteils chiffriert'; Bl. 540 partly deciphered, which gives a crib. Not on DECODE, not in the repo. 27 Oct 2026, Brice Dudout (email): the Dresden records are marked 'Fehlt: Kriegsfolge' (lost in 1945). 28 Oct 2026 (targets/knorre1462/): attempted; the whole volume Loc. 4356/01 ('Luxemburgische Sachen, I. Einzelne Schriften') and each ciphered sheet (Bl. 530, 538, 540, 575, the ciphered Befehl) are marked 'Fehlt: Kriegsfolge' on archiv.sachsen.de; no images, no edition, no second copy found. Only a pre-war film or a Burgundian/Weimar copy would reopen it.
why: Among the earliest German diplomatic ciphers: Saxony's embassy to Burgundy over the Luxembourg claim, 1462-63.
